description: This file implements an optimization pass (Dead Code Elimination) for unused extra outputs in HOP subgraphs within a Torch FX GraphModule. The core functionality includes collecting subgraph usages, checking if specific outputs are used, and removing unused outputs to optimize the graph.

methods.name: bool dce_hop_extra_outputs(gm: torch.fx.GraphModule)
methods.description: Main function to remove unused extra outputs from HOP calls in all submodules of the provided GraphModule, returning True if modifications were made.

methods.name: None _collect_all_subgraph_usages( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, subgraph_id_to_callers: dict[ int, list[tuple[torch.fx.GraphModule, str, torch.fx.Node]] ], )
methods.description: Recursively collects all usages of subgraphs within a GraphModule to identify call sites of HOP nodes with extra outputs.

methods.name: bool _is_output_used( output_idx: int, callers: list[tuple[torch.fx.GraphModule, str, torch.fx.Node]], )
methods.description: Checks if a specific output index is used by any caller (via getitem nodes with users).

methods.name: bool _dce_subgraph( subgraph: torch.fx.GraphModule, callers: list[tuple[torch.fx.GraphModule, str, torch.fx.Node]], used_indices: set[int], )
methods.description: Performs dead code elimination on a subgraph by removing unused output indices, updating getitem nodes in callers, and recompiling graphs.
